title: Racetrack (B-roll footage from the Racetrack. This video is silent.)
place: Racetrack Playa, Death Valley NP, California
audio: none (source has a silent track; dropped)
notes: 0-5.7 s: slow ground-level dolly toward a dark sailing stone sitting at the end of its long trail across the cracked hexagonal mud (stone at x~0.38, y~0.73; trail runs up-left to the horizon; mountains on top) - BEST seconds 0-5.5. 5.7-12.4 s: low dolly along a long curving rock trail on the cracked playa, no stone in view (trail x~0.4-0.55). Checked frames at 2/7/12 s: stone+trail, trail, trail. ~12.4-14 s: dissolve begins into a close-up of a big dark stone (x~0.6) - avoid the dissolve, use 0-12. Smooth slider moves, not handheld. No people, text or logos. Source 1280x720 30 fps upscaled.
fact_en: The Racetrack is a playa--a dry lakebed--best known for its strange moving rocks. NPS: remote observations from 2011 to 2013 showed it's a rare combination of water, ice, and wind.
